summary: Blacktail Mountain lookout: camp 1926, 40-foot L-4 tower 1936, destroyed 1947; a 1931 lightning death is recorded. Footings and ruins remain.

notes_for_editor: Camp, cabin, tower and destruction years agree across firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts. Unresolved: the 1931 death. The Idaho page dates it 6/17/31; newspaper reprints (dated June 23 and 24, 1931) say a Sunday evening. The victim's first name (James, Ben, Glen) and age (about 19 or 23) differ between reprints; the story says so. Idaho Fire Lookouts is unsure whether the Butler Mountain footings belong to the 1936 tower. Coordinates need a human check: the brief's record uses 48.13047, -116.52547 (idaho_fl), while the firelookout.org list and firelookout.com give 48.11893, -116.51886. No access or photo licence information found. Not a death to be sensationalised: the story keeps it to the sources. Verified 2026-10-10: the mine sentence now says located to match the quote.
